name: Soyo
source:
One of the girls living within the castle at the flower garden. A homely, gentle and timid onee-san who seems to be married. What is she hiding behind those sad eyes?

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/08/10/vanilla/]Official Site[/url]]
